title: Sum of Imbalance Numbers of All Subarrays
summary: The imbalance number of an array is the number of indices i in the sorted array where 0 <= i < n - 1 and sorted[i+1] - sorted[i] > 1. Return the sum of imbalance numbers over all subarrays of nums.
visualizationNotes: Input is capped at 20 values for the visualization; the official limit is 1000. Values are constrained to 1..length as officially stated.
